heading.title: Execution, Suspension, Remission and Commutation of Sentences

article.title: Commutation of sentence of death on pregnant woman
article.content:
456Commutation of sentence of death on pregnant woman

Section 456 · Chapter XXXIV · Death sentences
If a woman sentenced to death is found to be pregnant, the High Court shall commute the sentence to imprisonment for life.
